children: DeGods founder and trader Frank said his main perpetual futures wallet has not yet made an overall profit. According to Odaily, Frank made the clarification on X after community members called him “the best trader,” saying most of his earnings so far came from on-chain trading across previous market cycles. Frank previously ranked first in cumulative profit and loss on the Fomo platform, surpassing Bonk Guy, who has since moved ahead of him.

title: Trader Frank Says Main Perpetual Futures Wallet Is Not Yet Profitable Overall
